1.web: In the year that king Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
1.asv: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

2.web: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.
2.asv: Above him stood the seraphim: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

3.web: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
3.asv: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Jehovah of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

4.web: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
4.asv: And the foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.

5.web: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”
5.asv: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, Jehovah of hosts.

6.web: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
6.asv: Then flew one of the seraphim unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:

7.web: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”
7.asv: and he touched my mouth with it, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin forgiven.

8.web: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
8.asv: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then I said, Here am I; send me.

9.web: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand; and you see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
9.asv: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.

10.web: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”
10.asv: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.

11.web: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, and houses without man, and the land becomes utterly waste,
11.asv: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until cities be waste without inhabitant, and houses without man, and the land become utterly waste,

12.web: And Yahweh has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many in the midst of the land.
12.asv: and Jehovah have removed men far away, and the forsaken places be many in the midst of the land.

13.web: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed: as a terebinth, and as an oak, whose stock remains when they are felled; so the holy seed is its stock.”
13.asv: And if there be yet a tenth in it, it also shall in turn be eaten up: as a terebinth, and as an oak, whose stock remaineth, when they are felled; so the holy seed is the stock thereof.
